description: This source file implements a key-value pair vector data structure in C, providing functions for initialization, addition, removal, replacement, retrieval, validation, and destruction of key-value pairs. It manages dynamic memory and supports various data types such as strings, unsigned integers, booleans, date-times, hex numbers, and enums, making it central for handling structured key-value data within the software system.

methods.name: void KV_VECTOR_Init(kv_vector_t * kvv)
methods.description: Initializes the key-value vector structure by setting the vector pointer to NULL and zeroing the entry count.

methods.name: void KV_VECTOR_Add(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,char * value)
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the vector with string values, duplicating input strings.

methods.name: void KV_VECTOR_Remove(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key)
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair identified by key, freeing associated memory and maintaining array integrity.

methods.name: bool KV_VECTOR_Replace(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,char * value)
methods.description: Replaces all values for a specified key in the vector.

methods.name: bool KV_VECTOR_ReplaceWithHint(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,char * value,int hint)
methods.description: Replaces the value of the first occurrence of a key at the provided hint index, optimizing lookups.

methods.name: void KV_VECTOR_AddUnsigned(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,unsigned value)
methods.description: Adds a key with an unsigned integer value by converting it to string.

methods.name: void KV_VECTOR_AddBool(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,bool value)
methods.description: Adds a key with a boolean value represented as a string.

methods.name: void KV_VECTOR_AddDateTime(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,time_t value)
methods.description: Adds a date-time value as an ISO8601 string.

methods.name: void KV_VECTOR_AddEnum(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,int value,const enum_entry_t * enums,int num_enums)
methods.description: Adds a key with an enumeration value converted to string.

methods.name: void KV_VECTOR_AddHexNumber(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,unsigned char * buf,int len)
methods.description: Adds a binary buffer as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: void KV_VECTOR_Destroy(kv_vector_t * kvv)
methods.description: Frees all allocated memory within the vector and resets its state.

methods.name: void KV_VECTOR_Dump(kv_vector_t * kvv)
methods.description: Logs all key-value pairs for debugging.

methods.name: int KV_VECTOR_FindKey(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,int start_index)
methods.description: Finds index of a key in the vector starting from a hint index.

methods.name: char * KV_VECTOR_Get(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,char * default_value,int start_index)
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key or default.

methods.name: int KV_VECTOR_GetUnsigned(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,unsigned default_value,unsigned * value)
methods.description: Retrieves a key's value as an unsigned integer with type validation.

methods.name: int KV_VECTOR_GetUnsignedWithinRange(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,unsigned default_value,unsigned min,unsigned max,unsigned * value)
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned value and validates it falls within a specified range.

methods.name: int KV_VECTOR_GetInt(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,int default_value,int * value)
methods.description: Retrieves a key's value as an integer with type validation.

methods.name: int KV_VECTOR_GetIntWithinRange(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,int default_value,int min,int max,int * value)
methods.description: Retrieves an integer value and validates that it falls within a specified range.

methods.name: int KV_VECTOR_GetBool(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,bool default_value,bool * value)
methods.description: Retrieves a key's boolean value, parsing from string.

methods.name: int KV_VECTOR_GetDateTime(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,char * default_value,time_t * value)
methods.description: Retrieves a date-time value parsed from string.

methods.name: int KV_VECTOR_GetHexNumber(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,unsigned char * buf,int len,int * bytes_copied)
methods.description: Retrieves a hexadecimal string and converts it to a binary buffer.

methods.name: int KV_VECTOR_GetEnum(kv_vector_t * kvv,char * key,void * value,int default_value,const enum_entry_t * enums,int num_enums)
methods.description: Retrieves an enum value from string, converting it to internal representation.
